title: Humans and aliens working side by side at Mount Zeal

tellings.quote: And I've heard that from people who absolutely know for sure. Yeah.

plain: Humans and aliens are said to work side by side at Mount Zeil, a mountain in Australia. A former Army sergeant named Lyn Buchanan repeats this from what others told him, saying he has "heard that from people who absolutely know for sure," though he does not name them.
